messages:
maria (eng-runtime): quick ask — I'm trying to repro a customer latency spike in prod. Can we enable a very small (5%) temporary capture of request/response for the affected route so we can inspect prompts + model responses? Will store in an ephemeral S3 bucket for up to 48h. Not planning to capture API keys or raw headers with auth. pinging sec for sign-off.
kevin (sre): how will access be controlled and who needs to see the data? also retention policy?
anika (security): a few quick constraints: 1) do NOT store bearer tokens/session cookies, 2) mask or truncate any full email addresses unless hashed, 3) limit access via an IAM role and require audit logging. 48h is reasonable if we auto-delete afterwards. Please include a ticket and the business justification.
maria (eng-runtime): noted. Access: eng-runtime + incident responders only, IAM role eng-runtime-debug. Retention: lifecycle delete after 48h. We'll use a customer-scoped HMAC to pseudonymize user_id. We won't include the Authorization header in full. Example scrub rules I'm planning to apply:
```
- headers: remove Authorization, Cookie
- body: mask regex \"email:\\s*[^\\s\"']+\" -> hash(email)
- prompt: store full prompt up to 2k chars, truncate beyond that with marker [TRUNCATED]
- response: store full response up to 8k chars, truncate after that
- ids: hmac(user_id, env.KMS_SALT)
```
sam (product): do we need explicit user consent for this capture? it's internal debug data but it contains prompts that might include user PII.
anika (security): generally no end-user consent required for internal debugging, but you must minimize data and document the justification in the ticket. If PII appears in prompts, hash or redact it. Also ensure the KMS key used for HMAC is customer-scoped where possible. Add a reviewer from privacy if you expect many emails/SSNs in prompts.
maria (eng-runtime): thanks. I'll create the ticket now and link the bucket name and IAM ARNs. asking for a quick +1 so we can flip the flag for 5% and monitor.
anika (security): +1 from security contingent on: ticket exists (ENG-DEBUG-PII), lifecycle=48h, IAM role + explicit list of teammates, bucket encrypted with KMS, and no full auth headers stored. Post the ticket link here.
kevin (sre): I'll provision the ephemeral bucket with prefix `ephemeral-debug/1991234567/` and a restricted KMS key. Will not attach a public policy. Tell me the final IAM role names.
maria (eng-runtime): created ticket ENG-DEBUG-PII-448: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/ENG-DEBUG-PII-448 — includes justification, scrub config, and initial list of reviewers. tagging @anika @kevin
audit-bot: Ticket ENG-DEBUG-PII-448 created by maria (eng-runtime) and assigned to anika (security).
maria (eng-runtime): thanks all — will enable capture for 5% once kevin confirms bucket and anika confirms reviewers. will post follow-up when data is available. :thumbsup:
